{{Quote|Weizel has a certain flair for handling problem worlds. Like the Dakshee affair. Who would have guessed the union heads were JAN ringleaders? But Weizel sniffed them out, and resolved the issue without bloodshed.|Amier Candle on Gerald Weizel's appointment as Governor of Chandrila|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
'''Amier Candle''' was the department head of [[Imperial University]]'s [[School of Public Policy]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Candle commented on the appointment of [[Gerald Weizel]] to the post of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]].
